verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product, so running it headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any runnable tool, CLI or API; its mention of internal use of AI and automated translation is not a client-runnable automation capability, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
